        <payload><?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="DELETE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>global.CreateAssessment</api_name><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><name>CreateAssessment</name><script><![CDATA[var CreateAssessment = Class.create();

CreateAssessment.prototype = Object.extendsObject(AbstractAjaxProcessor,{
//  initialize : function() {
//  },
deleteAssessment: function() {
	var id = this.getParameter('sysparm_id');
	var ta = new GlideRecord('task_assessment');
	if (ta.get(id) && !ta.getValue('instance'))
			ta.deleteRecord();
},
  checkAssessment: function() {
   var id = this.getParameter('sysparm_id');
   var tabClass = this.getParameter('sysparm_class');
   var assessmentID = '';
   var match = false;

   var gr = new GlideRecord(tabClass);
   gr.get(id);

   //see if an assessment already exists
   var ta = new GlideRecord('task_assessment');
   ta.addQuery('task', gr.sys_id);
   ta.query();

   //look for matching assessment to attach
   var ac = new GlideRecord('assessment_conditions');
   ac.addQuery('table', tabClass);
   ac.addActiveQuery();
   ac.orderBy('order');
   ac.query();
   var retTA = 'No Condition';
   while (ac.next()) {
      var filter = GlideFilter;
      match = filter.checkRecord(gr, ac.condition);      
      if (match){
        retTA = this._setAssessment(gr, ac, ta);
        break; //match found so use this one
      }
   }
   if (retTA == 'No Condition' && ta.next()){
     ta.deleteRecord();
   }
   return retTA;
  },
	
	/**
	 * Prevent public access to this processor
	 */
	isPublic: function() {
		return false;
	},

//look for existing assessment against the task - there should be only one!
//If a task_assessment exists and the assessment to take has changed then delete the existing and create a new one
//if no task_assessment exists then create a new one
  _setAssessment: function(task, ac, ta) { 
    var ret = ''; 
    if (ta.next()){ 
      // Existing assessment instance exists and is of the same type
      if (ta.assessment == ac.assessment){
        ret = ta.sys_id + ',' + ta.assessment.name;
      }
      // Existing assessment instance exists and is different so delete and associate correct one
      else{
        ta.deleteRecord();
        ret = this._create_task_assessment(ta, task.sys_id, ac);
      }
    }
    // First time assessment taken so create new one
    else{
      ret = this._create_task_assessment(ta, task.sys_id, ac);
    }

    return ret;
  }, 

  _create_task_assessment: function(gr, taskID, assessment) { 
      gr.initialize();
      gr.task = taskID;
      gr.assessment = assessment.assessment;
      gr.insert();
      var name = assessment.assessment.name;
      var id = gr.sys_id;
      var res = id + ',' + name;
      return res;
  },

type: 'CreateAssessment'

});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>Ludovic.Andre@fxinnovation.com</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2018-07-27 19:53:03</sys_created_on><sys_customer_update>false</sys_customer_update><sys_id>5c5bd6bddb6b57c0d345de82ca9619b8</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>CreateAssessment</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_replace_on_upgrade>false</sys_replace_on_upgrade><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_5c5bd6bddb6b57c0d345de82ca9619b8</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>Ludovic.Andre@fxinnovation.com</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2018-07-27 19:53:03</sys_updated_on><u_fx_inactive>false</u_fx_inactive><u_source/><u_target/></sys_script_include></record_update></payload>
